title: Tutorial on Diffusion Models for Imaging and Vision

nodes.text: The underlying principle behind modern text-to-image and text-to-video generative tools is diffusion, a sampling mechanism that overcomes shortcomings deemed difficult in previous generative approaches.
nodes.evidence: The underlying principle behind these generative tools is the concept of diffusion, a particular sampling mechanism that has overcome some shortcomings that were deemed difficult in the previous approaches

nodes.text: The variational autoencoder (VAE) is presented as the conceptual basis for diffusion models, using an encoder distribution q_phi(z|x) and decoder distribution p_theta(x|z) trained by maximizing the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO).
nodes.evidence: 1 The Basics: Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) ... The loss function we use here is called the Evidence Lower BOund (ELBO)

nodes.text: The ELBO is a valid lower bound on log p(x) whose gap to log p(x) is exactly the KL divergence between the proxy posterior q_phi(z|x) and the true posterior p(z|x); the bound becomes tight when the proxy matches the true posterior.
nodes.evidence: the inequality will become an equality when our proxy qϕ(z|x) can match the true distribution p(z|x) exactly

nodes.text: The ELBO decomposes into a reconstruction term (how good the decoder is) and a prior-matching KL term (how good the encoder is) measuring how well the encoded latent follows the chosen prior N(0,I).

The tutorial covers three principal formulations of diffusion models: the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM), Score-Matching Langevin Dynamics (SMLD), and the unifying Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) framework.
nodes.evidence: 2 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) ... 3 Score-Matching Langevin Dynamics (SMLD) ... 4 Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE)

nodes.text: Both DDPM and SMLD can be expressed within the unified continuous-time SDE framework, with separate SDE formulations derived for each.
nodes.evidence: 4.3 Stochastic Differential Equation for DDPM ... 4.4 Stochastic Differential Equation for SMLD

nodes.text: The reparameterization trick samples a latent from a Gaussian via x = mu + Sigma^{1/2} w with w ~ N(0,I), enabling gradient-based training of the VAE encoder neural network that outputs mu_phi(x) and sigma_phi(x).
nodes.evidence: the sampling process can be done via the transformation of white noise x = μ + Σ 1/2 w

nodes.text: Score-Matching Langevin Dynamics relies on the Stein score function (the gradient of log-density) estimated via score-matching techniques, providing an alternative to the likelihood-based DDPM derivation.
A central premise of the entire family of diffusion models is the goal of drawing samples from the unknown true data distribution p(x), which is never directly known.
nodes.evidence: p(x): The distribution of x. It is never known ... The whole galaxy of diffusion models is to find ways to draw samples from p(x)

nodes.text: Inversion by Direct Denoising (InDI) is presented as an alternative DDPM-related formulation within the tutorial's treatment of denoising diffusion.
